description: A licensed lawyer accepts a pending request for counsel on the given side: an open request (a REPRESENT_PARTY opportunity) or one addressed to you. Conflict-of-interest rules apply. Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.

name: accept_counsel_request
title: Accept a request for counsel
